title: Yellowed Bouncy Irish Potato Bowl
description: A funky, bouncy Irish dish featuring green cardamom pods and shio-koji-cure, served in an earthenware bowl, this plant-based friendly meal is perfect for a unique dinner experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Scrub the irish potatoes clean and poke some holes in them with a fork to allow steam to escape.
Rub the potatoes with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Bake the potatoes directly on the middle rack of the oven for 45 minutes, or until they are cooked through and slightly yellowed.
While the potatoes are baking, heat the shio-koji mixture in a pan over low heat, stirring constantly, until it is fragrant and lightly browned.
Add the sliced onion and minced garlic to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is softened and lightly caramelized.
Stir in the crushed green cardamom pods and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
To assemble the bowls, slice the baked potatoes in half and place them in earthenware bowls.
Spoon the shio-koji and onion mixture over the potatoes, then sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
